params.caption: 🏆 FURIA vs Spirit: BLAST Rivals grand final is live It's grand final day at BLAST Rivals, with FURIA facing Team Spirit for the season's second-to-last trophy. FURIA reached the final after handing Vitality its first-ever 13-0 map loss in the quarter-finals, while Spirit got past MOUZ in the semis.
